summary: Share-immediate review: 0 critical. startExport awaits encodePromise then deliverExportFile in the Export click async continuation; onstop is File-only; download only when !canShare; ReplayTransportBar Ready to share + Share ≥44×44 + Share complete announce wiring OK. 22 related tests green. Two warnings (delivery-phase re-entry; stale Share UI after dismiss). nextStage qa-acceptance.
goal: Open native share sheet from the Export button’s user-gesture chain (no download prompt when shareable)

findings.issue: After encode, sessionRef is cleared and status becomes success before await deliverExportFile finishes. Export stays enabled (ClimbScene/ReplayTransportBar only disable for running|paused_hidden), so a second startExport can begin while the first share/download settlement is still pending; the first await then setStatus(success) can clobber the second encode’s running state.
findings.fix: Keep an inFlightDelivery/busy flag (or leave sessionRef occupied) until deliverExportFile settles; disable Export while delivery is in flight. Optional: ignore late setStatus unless a generation id still matches.

findings.issue: Late share settlement still applies UI updates without generation/file guards: Share onClick can setShareError/speak after Dismiss/re-export; auto-share’s final setStatus can resurrect success chrome after dismissStatus→idle.
findings.fix: Capture File identity or generation at share start; after await apply speak/setShareError/setStatus only if still success with that same file (or generation matches).

findings.issue: AC-SI-3 structural contract holds: onstop resolves File|null only; startExport awaits encodePromise then await deliverExportFile; ClimbScene/ReplayTransportBar invoke startExport from click. Browser may still drop user activation across long MediaRecorder encode — Share retry is the specified recovery.
findings.fix: None for implementer — QA device-check Export tap → sheet without download when canShare, and Share retry after NotAllowed/abort.

findings.issue: AC-SI-1/2/4/5 seams OK: deliverExportFile never downloads when canShare; download when false; exportSuccessLabel Ready to share; Share ≥44×44 on success when canShare; MIME honesty unchanged. Announce unit residual unchanged (verifier).
findings.fix: None — proceed to QA for gesture/announce residuals.

learnings.action: Advance to qa-acceptance; device-check Export → native sheet without download when canShare, Share retry after NotAllowed/abort, and Ready to share / Share complete announces.

learnings.insight: Clearing sessionRef and flipping to success before await deliverExportFile leaves Export enabled during share settlement, so a second startExport can race the first late setStatus.
learnings.action: Treat share/download delivery as part of the busy/export session: busy until deliverExportFile settles, or gate late setStatus on a generation id.

learnings.insight: Share-immediate AC-SI-3 critical bar is structural await order (onstop File-only; share after await encode inside click-started startExport), not proof that UA activation survives long encode.
learnings.action: Do not loopBack implementer for activation survival or announce unit residuals when deliverExportFile + startExport chain and Share retry chrome match AC-SI-1…5.
